michael: Heads-up — hitting a weird bug in the Python SDK async client around tool/function calling + structured outputs. The SDK is turning my returned dict into a list during post-processing :confused:

michael: Minimal repro below (async):
```py
from redwood_inference import AsyncClient
import asyncio

async def main():
    c = AsyncClient(api_key=... )
    resp = await c.tool_call(
        tool_name='catalog_lookup',
        input={'query': 'widgets'},
        structured_output=True
    )
    # expecting resp.tool_output to be a dict, but it's a list
    print(type(resp.tool_output), resp.tool_output)

asyncio.run(main())
```

sam: can you paste the exact raw response body from the model/service? sometimes the raw has an array wrapper

michael: server returned this (raw):
```json
{"id":"msg-1","tool_output":{"items":{"a":1,"b":2}}}
```

michael: but SDK parsed it into:
```py
# printed by the repro above
<class 'list'> [{'a': 1, 'b': 2}]
```

anya: any chance you have a custom type hint or dataclass on the call? we had a similar mismatch when typing was `List[Any]` vs `Mapping[str, Any]` in the old parser

ryan: which sdk version? also which Python version? :eyes:

michael: redwood-inference v0.9.4, Python 3.11. No custom type hints — plain `structured_output=True` and I rely on the SDK to coerce into dicts

sam: hmm looking at previous bugs, maybe parser uses `collections.abc.Sequence` check before `Mapping` and that makes plain dict-like objects (e.g., OrderedDict subclass?) get treated weirdly if the object implements __iter__ weirdly. can you run a quick introspect on the raw field? `isinstance(x, Mapping), isinstance(x, Sequence)`

michael: quick check: `isinstance(raw_tool_output, dict)` -> True; `isinstance(parsed, list)` -> True. stack trace snippet:
```
AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'get'
  File ".../site-packages/redwood_inference/async_client.py", line 412, in _parse_structured_output
    return parsed.get('items')
```

ci-bot: CI: v0.9.x branch test run started (build #2342) :gear:

sam: likely a bug in the SDK's post-parse normalization step. I can reproduce locally with your payload. quick hack: swap the isinstance checks so Mapping is checked before Sequence. that fixes my local run

michael: monkeypatch worked for me too. Would prefer proper fix + unit test

anya: I'm drafting a PR with a small reorder + an extra test that asserts `tool_output` stays a mapping when input was mapping. pushed to draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4567 (DRAFT)

sam: adding integration test for async roundtrip and a typed model test. also noted to add a changelog entry

ryan: reviewed locally, tests failing only on old stdlib before 3.10, will add guard. approving once CI green. I'll handle backport to 0.9.x after merge

michael: thanks! any ETA for release?

ryan: planning to cut 0.9.5 tomorrow AM PST. After merge I'll trigger release pipeline and ping this thread
